production_fields.phone: text — candidate phone; NOT written to users.phone until TX-3 commits
production_fields.code: text — OTP value; never logged or included in error responses
production_fields.is_used: bool — set true on consume or expire

isolated_env_only.adapter_status: select: pending_send, sent_active, send_failed, expired, consumed
isolated_env_only.requesting_user_id: text (15 chars) — e.auth.id from request route; verified in TX-3

users_schema.phone: text — written only by OTP adapter TX-3 or NSU emergency recovery
users_schema.phone_verified: bool — written atomically with phone inside TX-3

otp_user_binding.cross_user_test: T-PHONE-OTP-CROSS-USER — User B's token rejected for User A's OTP

expiry_design.pattern: Return-from-TX commits expired state; throw OUTSIDE TX rejects request.

tx2_cleanup_design.error_handling: Not swallowed; 500 returned if cleanup fails
tx2_cleanup_design.sanitized_errors: No record IDs, no raw exceptions in client response

transaction_api.usage: TX-1 (create pending), TX-2 (activate), TX-3 (verify+consume). All via $app.runInTransaction().

rate_limit_note: D23-12/D24-12: Persistent rate-limit policy DEFERRED-MANDATORY. No safety claim made.
